newsitem.title: ESTONIA: SAKU MARKET SHARE SLIGHTLY DOWN.
newsitem.headline: SAKU MARKET SHARE SLIGHTLY DOWN.

text.p: Saku Brewery said on Thursday it had 48 percent of the Estonian market at the end of April, down by five points from the same period last year.
Some 40 percent was held by local producers and the rest by importers, Cardo Remmel, director of Saku, told a news conference.
Saku lost some market share because it decided to give up active sales in kiosks as this does not reflect its quality strategies, he added.
The Estonian beer market amounted to 14.65 million litres in the first four months, up 12 percent from the same period last year.
Saku is owned by Baltic Beverages, a joint venture between Finnish Hartwall and Nordic brewer Pripps.
